missing_results.label: cor:high-prob
missing_results.description: Impossibility result: no strategy has a high-probability regret bound of order C sqrt((K-1)T) log^p(1/delta) with p < 1 that holds for every delta.
missing_results.quote: If $p \in (0,1)$ and $C > 0$, then there does not exist a strategy such that for all $T$, $K$, $\ell_{1:T} \in [0,1]^{KT}$ and $\delta \in (0,1)$ the regret is bounded by $\Pr{R_T(\ell_{1:T}) \geq C \sqrt{(K-1)T} \log^p(1/\delta)} \leq \delta$.

summary: The extraction is accurate. All six lower bounds (Theorems 1–4 and Corollaries 4–5) have the correct constants, conditions, side and probability type, and the cited results match the introduction and Section 4. The only gap is Corollary 3, an impossibility statement for high-probability bounds, which the extractor deliberately left out but which is arguably a lower-bound result.
